about: South Stormont is a township in the United Counties of Stormont, Dundas and Glengarry, Ontario, west of Cornwall along the St. Lawrence River—not a city. Villages such as Ingleside and Long Sault, Seaway farmland, and Lost Villages heritage share the riverside landscape. About 13,000 people live in South Stormont Township.
